---
format:
  typst:
    papersize: us-letter
    fontsize: 8.5pt
    mainfont: "Segoe UI"
    keep-typ: true
    template-partials:
      - page.typ
---

<!-- heplots cheatsheet, 2 pages (layout "C": fit & visualize / check, refine & report).
     Layout is raw Typst; images come from dev/cheatsheet-figs.R. Build with dev/cheatsheet/build.R -->

```{=typst}
// ---- theme ------------------------------------------------------------
#let hl   = rgb("#4472C4")        // highlight: H ellipse blue from the hex logo
#let hl2  = rgb("#E00000")        // secondary: E ellipse red
#let pale = rgb("#EEF2FA")

// page setup (landscape, margins, footer) is in the page.typ template partial
#set text(font: ("Segoe UI", "Arial"), size: 8.5pt)
#set par(leading: 0.45em, spacing: 0.6em, justify: false)
#show raw: set text(font: ("Consolas", "Courier New"), size: 7.5pt)
#set list(indent: 0.3em, body-indent: 0.4em, spacing: 0.45em)

// ---- helpers ----------------------------------------------------------
// section panel: colored title with rule, like the Posit sheets
#let panel(title, subtitle: none, body) = block(width: 100%, breakable: false, above: 0.7em)[
  #block(below: 0.35em)[
    #text(size: 13pt, weight: "bold", fill: hl)[#title]
    #if subtitle != none [ #h(0.4em) #text(size: 7.5pt, style: "italic", fill: luma(80))[#subtitle] ]
  ]
  #line(length: 100%, stroke: 1.2pt + hl)
  #v(0.2em)
  #body
]

// thumbnail + code + description
#let thumb(img, code, desc, w: 1.0in) = grid(
  columns: (w, 1fr), column-gutter: 5pt,
  box(stroke: 0.4pt + luma(170), image("fig/" + img, width: w)),
  align(horizon)[
    #text(fill: hl, raw(code, lang: "r")) \
    #v(-0.15em)
    #text(size: 7.5pt)[#desc]
  ],
)

// shaded box for the "template"
#let tmpl(body) = block(fill: pale, inset: 5pt, radius: 3pt, width: 100%, body)

// stacked thumbnail: image on top, code + description below (for bigger images)
#let thumbv(img, code, desc, w: 1.7in) = block(width: 100%, breakable: false)[
  #align(center, box(stroke: 0.4pt + luma(170), image("fig/" + img, width: w)))
  #v(-0.2em)
  #text(fill: hl, raw(code, lang: "r")) \
  #v(-0.15em)
  #text(size: 7.5pt)[#desc]
]

// page theme strip under the banner
#let theme(num, title, sub) = block(width: 100%, fill: hl, inset: (x: 8pt, y: 4pt), radius: 2pt, above: 0.2em, below: 0.6em)[
  #text(fill: white, size: 11pt, weight: "bold")[#num #h(0.3em) #title]
  #h(1fr) #text(fill: white, size: 8pt, style: "italic")[#sub]
]

// ---- banner -----------------------------------------------------------
#let banner(logo-h: 0.65in, size: 22pt) = grid(columns: (1fr, auto), align: (left + horizon, right),
  [
    #text(size: size, weight: "bold")[Visualizing Multivariate Linear Models with heplots]
    #text(size: size, fill: luma(110))[:: CHEATSHEET]
  ],
  image("fig/logo.png", height: logo-h),
)

// =======================================================================
// PAGE 1: Fit & visualize
// =======================================================================
#banner()
#theme("①", "Fit & visualize", [fit an MLM, then see its tests as H and E ellipses])

#grid(columns: (27%, 1fr), column-gutter: 14pt,

// ===== left: Basics + template =====
[
#panel("Basics")[
  A *multivariate linear model* `lm(cbind(y1, y2, ...) ~ x1 + x2 + ...)`
  gives an object of class `"mlm"`. Tests of each term use two
  *SSP matrices*: #text(fill: hl)[*H*] (hypothesis) and #text(fill: hl2)[*E*] (error).

  An *HE plot* shows *H* and *E* as ellipses (ellipsoids in 3D) in
  the space of two (or three) responses.

  #grid(columns: (1fr, auto, 1fr), column-gutter: 3pt, align: horizon,
    image("fig/A1a-data-ellipses.png"), text(size: 14pt, fill: hl)[→],
    image("fig/A1b-heplot.png"))
  #grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr), align: center,
    text(size: 7pt)[data ellipses, by group], text(size: 7pt)[HE plot: H & E])

  - *Significance scaling* (default, `size = "evidence"`): a term is
    significant by Roy's test (α = .05) *iff its H ellipse projects outside E*
    somewhere.
  - `size = "effect"`: H and E on the scale of the data (effect size).
  - The *orientation* of H shows _how_ the responses relate to the effect.
]

#panel("Complete the template")[
  #tmpl[
    #set text(size: 7pt)
    ```r
    mod <- lm(cbind(<Y1>, <Y2>, ...)
              ~ <TERMS>, data = <DATA>)
    car::Anova(mod)    # MANOVA tests
    heplot(mod,
      variables = <1:2>,  # responses
      terms = <TERMS>,    # H ellipses
      hypotheses = <HYP>, # contrasts
      size = "evidence",  # "effect"
      fill = TRUE)
    ```
  ]
]
],

// ===== right: HE plot family + hypotheses =====
[
#panel("HE plot family", subtitle: raw("mod <- lm(cbind(Sepal.Length, …, Petal.Width) ~ Species, data = iris)"))[
  #grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr, 1fr), column-gutter: 14pt, row-gutter: 9pt,
    thumbv("B1-heplot.png", "heplot(mod)", [2D HE plot for two responses]),
    thumbv("B2-heplot-effect.png", "heplot(mod, size = \"effect\")", [effect-size scaling: H and E on the data scale]),
    thumbv("B3-pairs.png", "pairs(mod)", [all pairwise HE plots: an HE plot matrix]),
    thumbv("B4-heplot3d.png", "heplot3d(mod)", [3D HE ellipsoids (rgl); spin & zoom]),
    thumbv("B5-heplot1d.png", "heplot1d(mod)", [1D HE plot: H & E as intervals]),
    thumbv("B6-candisc.png", "heplot(candisc(mod))", [*candisc*: HE plot in canonical space, with variable vectors]),
  )
]

#panel("Tests of linear hypotheses", subtitle: [`hypotheses =`: contrasts or linear combinations of coefficients])[
  #grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr, 0.8fr), column-gutter: 12pt, align: horizon,
    thumb("C1-hypotheses.png", "heplot(mod, hypotheses = hyp)",
      [1-df contrasts are drawn as *lines*: e.g., setosa vs. others; versicolor vs. virginica], w: 1.55in),
    thumb("C2-mmra.png", "heplot(mod, hypotheses =\n  list(Regr = preds))",
      [MMRA: overall test of all predictors vs. each one (`Rohwer`)], w: 1.55in),
    [
      A 1-df H "ellipse" is a line. For a quantitative predictor, it shows the
      direction of its regression coefficients in the response space.

      A joint hypothesis (`Regr`) collects several terms into one H ellipse.
    ],
  )
]
],
)

#pagebreak()

// =======================================================================
// PAGE 2: Check, refine & report
// =======================================================================
#banner(logo-h: 0.45in, size: 15pt)
#theme("②", "Check, refine & report", [assumptions, customization, statistics])

#grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr, 30%), column-gutter: 14pt,

// ===== col 1: homogeneity of covariance =====
[
#panel("Homogeneity of covariance", subtitle: [`peng` data])[
  #grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr), column-gutter: 10pt, row-gutter: 7pt,
    thumbv("F1-covEllipses.png", "covEllipses(Y, group)", [within-group covariance ellipses (+ pooled)], w: 1.5in),
    thumbv("F2-covEllipses-matrix.png", "covEllipses(..., variables = 1:3)", [scatterplot matrix version], w: 1.5in),
    thumbv("F3-boxM.png", "plot(boxM(mod))", [log determinants of group covariance matrices, with CIs], w: 1.5in),
    thumbv("F4-boxM-boot.png", "plot_boxM_boot(...)", [bootstrap CIs for other eigenvalue statistics], w: 1.5in),
  )
  #v(0.2em)
  `boxM(Y, group)` or `boxM(mod)`: Box's M test. \
  `logdetCI()`, `eigstatCI()`, `traceCI()`: other summaries. \
  `bartlettTests()`, `leveneTests()`: univariate tests, one per response.
]
],

// ===== col 2: normality, outliers, robust =====
[
#panel("Normality, outliers & robust fits", subtitle: [`peng` data])[
  #grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr), column-gutter: 10pt, row-gutter: 7pt,
    thumbv("G1-cqplot.png", "cqplot(mod)", [χ² QQ plot of squared Mahalanobis distances of residuals], w: 1.5in),
    thumbv("G2-distancePlot.png", "distancePlot(mod)", [distances of X vs. residuals, with cutoff; labeled outliers], w: 1.5in),
    thumbv("G3-robmlm-weights.png", "plot(robmlm(mod))", [observation weights from a robust MLM], w: 1.5in),
    thumbv("G4-robust-heplot.png", "heplot(rmod)\nheplot(mod, add = TRUE)", [robust (solid) vs. classical (dashed): outliers inflate classical E (simulated)], w: 1.5in),
  )
  #v(0.2em)
  `Mahalanobis()`: with robust center/cov. `noteworthy()`: unusual points to label.
  See *mvinfluence* for influence diagnostics.
]
],

// ===== col 3: customizing + coefficients =====
[
#panel("Customizing HE plots")[
  - `variables`: which responses (indices or names)
  - `terms`, `hypotheses`: what to draw; `term.labels`, `hyp.labels`
  - `size = "evidence" | "effect"`, `alpha`, `level`
  - `col`, `lty`, `lwd`, `fill`, `fill.alpha`: one per ellipse
  - `factor.means`, `grand.mean`, `markH0`, `center.pch`
  - `add = TRUE`: overlay; `xlim`, `ylim`, `offset.axes`
  - Repeated measures: `idata`, `idesign`, `imatrix`, `iterm`

  #grid(columns: (0.95in, 1fr), column-gutter: 6pt, align: horizon,
    box(stroke: 0.4pt + luma(170), image("fig/D1-label-pos.png", width: 0.95in)),
    [
      `label.pos`: where to put labels
      - `0:4` = C, S, W, N, E
      - compass `"N"`, `"NE"`, … `"NW"`
      - a fraction 0–1 around the ellipse
      - see `label.ellipse()`
    ],
  )
]

#panel("Coefficients", subtitle: [`Rohwer` data])[
  #thumb("E1-coefplot.png", "coefplot(mod)",
    [joint confidence ellipses for the coefficients of each predictor; an ellipse
     excluding (0, 0) is significant], w: 0.95in)
  #v(0.2em)
  `stdcoef(mod)`, `stdmodel(mod)`: standardized coefficients & model
]

#panel("Other plots", subtitle: [`peng` data])[
  #grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr), column-gutter: 8pt,
    thumbv("I1-interpPlot.png", "interpPlot(xy1, xy2)",
      [interpolate between two data sets, e.g., data → residuals], w: 0.95in),
    thumbv("I2-pvPlot.png", "pvPlot(Y, vars)",
      [partial variables plot: two variables, controlling for the others], w: 0.95in),
  )
]
],
)

// ===== bottom strip: statistics + learn more =====
#grid(columns: (1fr, 30%), column-gutter: 14pt,
[
#panel("Model statistics")[
  #set table(stroke: none, inset: (x: 4pt, y: 2.5pt))
  #show table.cell.where(y: 0): set text(weight: "bold", fill: hl)
  #grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr), column-gutter: 12pt,
    table(columns: (auto, 1fr),
      fill: (_, y) => if calc.odd(y) { pale },
      [Function], [Returns],
      [`car::Anova(mod)`], [multivariate tests: Pillai, Wilks, H-L, Roy],
      [`etasq(mod)`], [multivariate η² (partial effect size) per term],
      [`uniStats(mod)`], [univariate R², F, p for each response],
      [`glance(mod)`], [one row per response, like `broom::glance()`],
    ),
    table(columns: (auto, 1fr),
      fill: (_, y) => if calc.odd(y) { pale },
      [Function], [Returns],
      [`termMeans(mod, "term")`], [response means for the levels of a factor],
      [`vcov(mod)`], [covariance matrix of the coefficients],
      [`df.terms(mod)`], [df for each term],
      [`colMeansList()`, `covList()`], [statistics for each group],
    ),
  )
]
],
[
#panel("Learn more")[
  - *Vignettes*: `HE_manova`, `HE_mmra`, `Robust`, `datasets`
  - *Related*: *candisc* (canonical views), *mvinfluence*, *car*, *rgl*
  - Friendly (2007) _JCGS_; Friendly, Monette & Fox (2013) _Stat. Sci._

  *Datasets* (37; see `vignette("datasets")`):
  #grid(columns: (auto, 1fr), column-gutter: 6pt, row-gutter: 3pt,
    text(fill: hl)[MANOVA], [`Plastic`, `Skulls`, `AddHealth`, `MockJury`, `peng`],
    text(fill: hl)[MMRA], [`Rohwer`, `Hernior`, `SocGrades`, `NLSY`],
    text(fill: hl)[Repeated], [`VocabGrowth`, `WeightLoss`, `Adopted`],
  )
]
],
)
```
